releaseNotes:
⚡ Smooth 60 FPS & Fail-Proof Installer Update (v1.1.7) by Dhiraj:
• 🚀 Zero-Lag Performance: Completely eliminates app freezing and stuttering. Large photo and media attachments now decode asynchronously with an in-memory LruCache, ensuring buttery-smooth 60 FPS scrolling
• 📦 100% Reliable In-App Update: Fixes update download timeouts and install failures using 32KB streaming buffers, 60s network resilience, and seamless package installer permissions
• 🛑 No Duplicate Popups: Residual update files in cache are automatically purged on install
• 💡 Crystal-Clear Guidance: Clear instructions on Android's update/install prompt so every user can update effortlessly with zero data loss
